profile.name: Muhamad Albani Syahril
profile.tagline: I am an AI & Software Engineer who builds end-to-end production AI systems across STT, LLMs, TTS, and RAG, with a track record of owning AI delivery independently.
bio: Hi! I'm Albani, an AI & Software Engineer with a proven track record of architecting end-to-end machine learning pipelines and advanced NLP systems.

Expertise spans from executing cost-efficient LLM integrations and robust backend orchestration (FastAPI, Redis, Celery, Kafka) to designing high-precision RAG architectures and low-latency TTS models.
Adept at balancing technical innovation with strict resource constraints to deliver scalable, secure, and highly optimized production environments.

experience.description: Solo AI engineer owning the AI layer of an interactive, voice-driven 3D simulation platform, designing and shipping narrative branching logic, RAG-based retrieval, and localized speech synthesis.
highlights: Designed technical specifications and defined solutions for new feature development, ensuring system scalability and preventing performance overhead
Architected a dynamic, prompt-driven narrative branching system, replacing legacy hard-coded transitions and improving branch routing accuracy by ~40% on a quantized model

Redesigned the AI decision-making architecture for dynamic narrative branching by implementing an embedding-based semantic scoring model. This resolved storyline inconsistencies and achieved an approximately 90% accuracy rate in intent detection for branch triggering

Identified and resolved a critical semantic bias in the RAG pipeline. Refactored the embedding strategy to index only question intents via FAISS, utilizing MongoDB for post-retrieval payload resolution. This architectural shift guaranteed high-precision semantic matching and boosted overall retrieval accuracy approximately 55%

Developed a shell script to automate Docker container isolation transitions between staging and client demo environments for resource-heavy AI models, eliminating manual rebuilds and reducing environment switching time by over 93%

Fine-tuned and deployed a localized TTS model to resolve Singaporean accent pronunciation issues, replacing the old TTS model and reducing inference latency by over 50% (from 3-4 seconds to an average of 1.5 seconds)
Working and handle all alone

experience.description: Solo AI engineer responsible for the full lifecycle of AI projects, from establishing a standardized codebase and developing models to building secure, scalable inference APIs and deploying them to production with Docker.
highlights: Initiate the first end-to-end AI project independently, establishing a standardized project structure for future codebase scalability. Engineered performance optimizations that improved preprocessing efficiency by 81% and training resource utilization by 72%. The final model was operationalized using FastAPI for serving and containerized with Docker Compose for deployment

Suggesting other techniques such as few shot prompting compared to supervised fine tuning llm, which has limited resources for training and inference due to very long inputs and inconsistent dataset, causing out of memory cuda to PM and have successfully solved business problems and saved 90% in server costs by relying on the gemini API

Developing a scalable and secure API endpoint for model inference utilizing Redis for traffic throttling, JWT for stateless security, and Celery for asynchronous task processing to optimize resource utilization
Tackle every problem I met as a solo AI Engineer
Helping data engineer setup distributed airflow using docker compose
Acted as a primary technical point of contact, recognized by project leadership for consistently resolving complex development challenges and system blockers

experience.description: Short-term engagement in the court’s planning, IT and reporting division, translating operational problems into technical solutions, including an integrated cross-division data bank interface and a fine-tuned Whisper speech-to-text model for transcription.
highlights: Brainstorming with supervisor
Transform user problem to technical solution
Creating data bank to integrated data from various division into one system (Only Front End Was Completed)
Creating AI model to transcript speech to text using transfer learning with Whisper OpenAI and LoRA technique
Creating a simple UI for AI model to inference using streamlit

experience.description: Independent engineer delivering end-to-end technical solutions for clients, spanning machine learning model development, system and database design, data pipelines, and web and mobile applications from requirements through delivery.
highlights: Building machine learning model (object detection, recommendation system, customer segmentation, etc)
Creating system design (UML) such as use case diagram, class diagram, activity diagram, sequence diagram, etc
Create UI/UX design
Creating simple data pipeline for ETL
Building simple mobile application and website application
Design database and normalization database
